claim: 二元论吠檀多原称/自称 Tattvavāda（'实在论之声'），由 13 世纪摩陀婆创立；'Dvaita' 为后加名（I04 包口径）。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta：'originally known as Tattvavada; IAST: Tattvavāda), is a sub-school in the Vedanta tradition of Hindu philosophy. The term Tattvavada literally means "arguments from a realist viewpoint". The Tattvavada (Dvaita) Vedanta sub-school was founded by the 13th-century Indian philosopher-saint Madhvacharya.'
note: 本包范围与命名处理的直接依据；句首的条目名与注音（'Dvaita Vedanta (/'dvaitə...'）从略。

claim: IEP 定位：二元论为吠檀多三大主要学派之一；13 世纪南印度起源；摩陀婆自认风神化身（神学层）。
locator: IEP Madhva：'Madhva's Dvaita Vedanta is recognized as one of the three major schools of Vedanta (besides Sankara's Advaita and Ramanuja's Visistadvaita Vedanta).'；导语：'The Dvaita or "dualist" school of Hindu Vedanta philosophy originated in 13th-century South India with Sri Madhvacarya (Madhva). Madhva, who considered himself an avatara of the wind-god Vayu, argued that...'
note: 化身自述在 IEP 为直陈、在维基有 Mesquita 质疑链——本包按并陈处理（见 /school/overview/19）。

claim: 名称内部争议：Sharma 认为英语 Dualism 不达意，拟 Svatantra-Advitiya-Brahmavāda；Aluru Venkata Rao 拟 Pūrnabrahmavāda。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta（Other names 节）：'The English term Dualism is inadequate to express the full content and depth of meaning that Madhva has put into the term Dvaita'（维基引 Sharma 语，其后接 'not literally capable of expressing more than the fundamental principles accepted'）；'Aluru Venkata Rao opines that the term Dvaita is not suitable for Madhva's philosophy, hence it should not be used.'
note: 支持 packet 副标题以 Tattvavāda 为准名的处理。

claim: 形而上学核心：两界实在——独立（唯梵）与依他（命我与物质）。
locator: IEP Madhva：'According to Madhva there are two orders of reality: 1. svatantra, independent reality, which consists of Brahman alone and 2. paratantra, dependent reality, which consists of jivas (souls) and jada (lifeless objects).'
note: 维基 Madhvacharya 引语框侧证：'Reality is twofold: independent and dependent things. The Lord Vishnu is the only independent thing.'

claim: 梵＝毗湿奴且释经强制：'梵'一词只能指毗湿奴，异说经典被宣布无权威。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta：'He stated: "Brahmaśabdaśca Viṣṇaveva", that Brahman can only refer to Vishnu. Scriptures which say different are declared as non-authoritative by him.'

claim: 神是有属性（saguṇa）位格神；体系内 nirguṇa 只是'离不圆满'属性之名，不构成低于 saguṇa 的层级。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta：'Madhvacharya posits God as being personal and saguna, that is endowed with attributes and qualities (in human terms, which are not believed to be able to fully describe God).'；'There is no gradation of Brahman into Saguna and Nirguna; Nirguna is understood as being free from all kinds of imperfections and is itself a guna (attribute) of the Supreme.'

claim: 五别（pañca-bheda）：IEP 列举版。
locator: IEP Madhva（Dvaita Vedanta 节）：'In Madhva's view the sacred texts teach pancabheda, the five-fold difference between 1. Visnu and jivas 2. Visnu and jada 3. jiva and jada 4. one jiva and another and 5. one form of jada and another.'
note: packet 卷首引语即取此句（截取）。

claim: 五别：维基列表版（五者皆'fundamental, eternal and real'）与 prapañca 词源。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta：'Five fundamental, eternal and real differences are described in Dvaita school:'（下分五条：命我与神／物质与神／命我彼此／物质与命我／物质彼此）；'These five differences are said to explain the nature of the universe. The world is called prapañca (pañca "five") by the Dvaita school for this reason.'
note: 两版编号次序略异（IEP 版物质项在后），本包以维基列表为主、IEP 版照录于 cihai。

claim: 命我如影（bimba-pratibimba），解脱后亦不与神同一，且彼此不平等。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta（Jivas 节）：'The individual souls (jiva) are depicted as reflections, images or shadows of the divine (bimba-pratibimba), but never in any way (even after moksha, or liberation) identical with the divine.'；'Liberated jivas do not attain equality with Brahman and also are not equal to each other.'

claim: Taratamya（多元中的等级）：差异是万物的永恒自然属性；海/池/罐满喻。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya（Metaphysics 节）：'This difference is neither temporary nor merely practical; it is an invariable and natural property of everything. Madhva calls it Taratamya (gradation in pluralism).'；'The sea is full; the tank is full; a pot is full; everything is full, yet each fullness is different, asserted Madhvacharya.'；'Taratamya is based on inherent differences amongst all beings. These differences determine whether souls are eligible for liberation, rebirth, or darkness.'
note: 任务提示 'Taratham?' 经核实为 Taratamya，据来源写入。

claim: 认识论：Anu pramana，三量（现量/比量/圣言-āgama），另立 kevala-pramāṇa；知识内在有效、能知所知各自实在；毗湿奴是吠陀之师非作者。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya（Epistemology 节）：'Madhva calls epistemology Anu pramana. It accepts three pramānas, that is three facts or three correct means of knowledge, in contrast to one of Charvaka and six of Advaita schools of Hindu philosophies'；'Madhva and his followers introduced kevala-pramana as the "knowledge of an object as it is", separate from anu-pramana described above.'；'Madhva's school of thought assert that knowledge is intrinsically valid, and the knower and the known are independently real.'；'Vishnu, according to Madhvacharya, is not the creator of the Vedas, but the teacher of the Vedas.'

claim: 实在论认识论的论证动机：知觉比量必须内在有效，否则经典可知性瓦解；经文不能教梵我同一，因与经验矛盾。
locator: IEP Madhva（Dvaita Vedanta 节）：'Madhva argues that perception and inference must be innately valid and the reality they present us with must be actually and ultimately real since such a position is the only one that allows us to know the content of the Vedas.'；'Madhva argued that the scriptures could not teach the identity of all beings because this would contradict ordinary perception, which tells us that we are different both from one another and from God.'

claim: tat tvam asi 的标志性重读：atat tvam asi（'汝非彼'）。
locator: IEP Madhva（Canonical Sources 节）：'Madhva rendered the phrase atat tvam asi or "you are not that."'（其前句为 By carrying over the 'a' from the preceding word——'a' 在 IEP 中带单引号，述移接之法）
note: 维基侧证（Sharma 口径）：'Madhva reinterpreted it to emphasize difference (bheda) rather than identity (abheda), understanding such statements as expressing "the special immanence of the Deity in every jot and tittle of Matter and Spirit".'

claim: 对不二论的批判立场：'vociferously attacked'；'以吠檀多为幌子传授佛教'指控；四部专批书（含 Upadhikhandana、Tattvodyota）。
locator: IEP Madhva：'This is markedly different from the earlier Advaita Vedanta, which Madhva often vociferously attacked.'；Wikipedia Madhvacharya（Views on other schools 节）：'Madhvacharya was most ardent critic of Advaita Vedanta, accusing Shankara and the Advaitins of teaching Buddhism under the cover of Vedanta.'；'Of all schools, Madhva directed his critique at Advaita most, penning four major texts, including Upadhikhandana and Tattvadyota, primarily dedicated to scrutinizing Advaita.'
note: 任务提示的'māyāvāda 不可救药'类名言梵文原句未核到一手文本，本包只写此转述层（见 evidenceLimits）。

claim: 对罗摩奴阇：接受其实在世界与位格神，拒绝限定不二论为不彻底的中间立场；灵魂论'质与量皆多元'对'质一元量多元'。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta（Vishishtadvaita 节）：'Madhva accepted Ramanuja's affirmation of a real world and a personal God, but rejected his qualified non-dualism as an inconsistent middle ground.'；Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'While the older school of Vishishtadvaita asserted "qualitative monism and quantitative pluralism of souls", states Sharma, Madhvacharya asserted both "qualitative and quantitative pluralism of souls".'

claim: 两代复注把二元论推上与诸派平等的立足点；Dasgupta 评价。
locator: Wikipedia Jayatirtha：'He structured the philosophical aspects of Dvaita and through his polemical works, elevating it to an equal footing with the contemporary schools of thought.'；Wikipedia Jayatirtha（引 Dasgupta）：'Jayatirtha and Vyasatirtha present the highest dialectical skill in Indian thought'；Wikipedia Vyasatirtha 另引：'The logical skill and depth of acute dialectical thinking shown by Vyasa-tirtha stands almost unrivalled in the whole field of Indian thought'.
note: 审计更正 2026-10-04：'highest dialectical skill' 句出自 Jayatirtha 页（S4），'stands almost unrivalled' 句出自 Vyasatirtha 页（S5），原文先前的'同页另引'误标。

claim: Nyāyāmṛta 引发不二论阵营 Advaitasiddhi 起的数世纪注战链。
locator: Wikipedia Vyasatirtha：'His Nyayamruta caused a stir in the Advaita community across the country requiring a rebuttal by Madhusudhana Saraswati through his text, Advaitasiddhi.'；'Vanamali Mishra composed a refutation of the Bramhananda Saraswati's work and the controversy eventually died down.'

claim: SEP 学术级锚点：当代知觉争论中 Chaturvedi 援引'Dvaita 哲学家 Vyāsatīrtha'回应 Gaṅgeśa。
locator: SEP Epistemology in Classical Indian Philosophy（9.2 节）：'He insightfully appeals to the work of the Dvaita philosopher Vyāsatīrtha in his response to Gaṅgeśa.'
note: 本条目其余部分为正理/弥曼差/不二论内容；SEP 印度知觉条目核读后无 Dvaita 实质内容（见 evidenceLimits）。

claim: 解脱论：神恩为唯一希望（IEP）；解脱是体认一切有限实在对至上的依赖（维基）。
locator: IEP Madhva：'Attaining Visnu's grace is the soul's only hope of achieving liberation [moksa] from the cycle of rebirth (samsara).'；Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta：'Moksha (liberation) is described as the realization that all finite reality is essentially dependent on the Supreme.'

claim: 神学/圣传层与文献批判：化身说文本依据的四百年批判—回应链（Appayya→Venkatasubbhiah→Mesquita→Sharma/Shrisha Rao）。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya（Interpretations 节）：'Many of Madhvacharya's scriptural citations cannot be traced to any known existing texts, a problem first raised by rival scholars centuries ago.'；'...the textual basis cited for some such claims has been questioned in modern scholarship, especially by Roque Mesquita, who argued that a number of scriptural sources adduced by Madhva in support of this and other doctrines are untraceable and were likely composed by Madhva himself under what he believed to be divine inspiration.'；'This view has been contested by Dvaita scholars such as B. N. K. Sharma and Shrisha Rao, who argue that Mesquita's research was incomplete...'
note: 本包据此把化身说/奇迹传按圣传层处理；两说并陈不裁决。

claim: 建制层：1285 建乌迪皮黑天道场；八僧团环列与 Paryaya；Mathatraya 与 24 僧团；礼仪依 Tantrasara。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'Madhva established the Krishna Mutt at Udupi with a murti secured from Dwarka Gujarat in 1285 CE.'；'Madhvacharya established eight mathas (monasteries) in Udupi with his eight disciples as its head along with Padmanabha Tirtha Matha.'；'the tradition of their studies and succession (Paryaya system) were established by Madhvacharya'；'The process and Vedic mantra rituals for Krishna worship in Dvaita monasteries follow the procedure written by Madhvacharya in Tantrasara.'；'Including mathas in Udupi, there are twenty-four Madhva mathas in India.'
note: 同页'never established a matha dedicated to Dvaita philosophy'句的张力见 evidenceLimits。

claim: 影响面：Kulandran/Kraemer 'salutary but not extensive'；对柴坦尼亚系影响最著（Sharma）；基督教影响说被拒；IEP 记外国影响说被共识拒绝。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta（Influence 节）：'Dvaita Vedanta and Madhvacharya's historical influence in Hinduism, state Kulandran and Kraemer, has been salutary, but not extensive.'；'According to Sharma, the influence of Dvaita Vedanta ideas have been most prominent on the Chaitanya school of Bengal Vaishnavism, and in Assam.'；Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'His writings led some early colonial-era Indologists such as George Abraham Grierson to suggest the 13th-century Madhva was influenced by Christianity, but later scholarship has rejected this theory.'；IEP Madhva：'Some scholars have speculated on "foreign," particularly Christian, influences on Madhva's thought but current scholarly consensus maintains that political and social changes in Madhva's region prompted a new approach to old religious convictions.'
note: 本包按'不夸大影响、不作比较宗教学推测'处理。

claim: 摩陀婆：生年不明、两系年代；Pajaka 出生、三名（Vasudeva/Purnaprajna/Anandatirtha）；师从 Achyutrapreksha 学不二论而不契，别立 tattvavada；不认其师。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya：'The biography of Madhvacharya is unclear about his year of birth. Many sources date him to 1238–1317 period, but some place him about the 1199–1278 period.'；'He joined an Advaita Vedanta monastery in Udupi (Karnataka), accepted his guru to be Achyutrapreksha... Madhva studied the Upanishads and the Advaita literature, but was unconvinced by its nondualism philosophy of oneness of human soul and god... left the monastery, and began his own tattvavada movement'；'Madhva never acknowledged Achyutrapreksha as his guru or his monastic lineage in his writings.'
note: 站外人物（philosophers.json python 子串查证无此人）；IEP 标题作 'Madhva (1238—1317)' 只用一系。

claim: 摩陀婆著作：三十七部（十三部奥义书注、Madhva-bhasya、Gita-bhasya、Rigveda 四十颂注、史诗诗体重估、Bhagavata-tatparya-nirnaya）；Anu-Vyakhyana 为代表作（Sharma）；Sarvamula Granthas 总集名；著作对外限阅之争（Sarma vs Bartley）。
locator: Wikipedia Madhvacharya（Works 节）：'Thirty seven Dvaita texts are attributed to Madhvacharya. Of these, thirteen are bhasya (review and commentary) on Principal Upanishads, a Madhva-bhasya on the foundational text of Vedanta school of Hinduism – Brahma Sutras, another Gita-bhasya on Bhagavad Gita, a commentary on forty hymns of the Rigveda, a review of the Mahabharata in poetic style, a commentary called Bhagavata-tatparya-nirnaya on Bhagavata Purana.'；'The Anu-Vyakhyana, a supplement to Madhvacharya's commentary on Brahma Sutras, is his masterpiece, states Sharma.'；'However, Bartley disagrees and states that this is inconsistent with the known history of extensive medieval Vedantic debates on religious ideas in India which included Dvaita school's ideas.'
note: infobox：'notable_works: Sarvamula Granthas'。限阅之争两说并陈。
uncertainty: 各著作具体年代无来源，不系年。

claim: 阇耶提尔塔：Ṭīkācārya 尊号；约1345–约1388、1365–1388 住持期；Deshastha 婆罗门贵族出身（Dhondopant Raghunath Deshpande，Mangalwedha）；师承 Akshobhya Tirtha；munitraya 之一。
locator: Wikipedia Jayatirtha：'Jayatirtha (Jaya-tīrtha), also known as Teekacharya (Ṭīkācārya) (c. 1345 – c. 1388), was a Hindu philosopher, dialectician, polemicist and the sixth pontiff of Madhvacharya Peetha from (1365 – 1388).'；'Born into an aristocratic Deshastha Brahmin family, he later adopted the cause of Dvaita after an encounter with the Madhva saint, Akshobhya Tirtha (d. 1365).'；'Along with Madhva and Vyasatirtha, he is venerated as one of the three great spiritual sages, or munitraya of Dvaita.'
note: 任务条目人物名'乌马拉蒂'与 Jayatirtha 不符（见 review.md）；另有圣传作者 Vyāsatīrtha 重名问题（维基自注 'not to be confused with Vyasatirtha'）。
uncertainty: 生年'约1345'与 Dandekar'1365–1388'（著述期）两口径并陈。

claim: 阇耶提尔塔著作：21 部（18 部为摩陀婆复注）；Nyaya Sudha 为《随释》复注、约 24,000 颂；Pramana Paddhati 与 Vadavali。
locator: Wikipedia Jayatirtha（Works 节）：'There have been 21 works accredited to Jayatirtha, 18 of which are commentaries on the works of Madhvacharya. Nyaya Sudha, which is a commentary on Madhva's Anu Vyakhyana, is considered to be his magnum opus. Running up to 24,000 verses, it discusses and critiques a variety of philosophers and their philosophies, ranging from the orthodox schools of Hinduism like Mimamsa and Nyaya to heterodox schools like Buddhism and Jainism, arguing in favour of Dvaita.'；'Pramana Paddhati is a short monograph on the epistemology of Dvaita dealing with the pramanas in question, the theory of truth and error and validity of knowledge, while Vadavali deals with the nature of reality and illusion.'

claim: 毗耶娑提尔塔：三说生卒并存（1447/1460/1469）；Vyasaraja、Chandrikacharya 别名；毗奢耶那伽罗国师；Vyasa Traya 三书；Nyayamruta→Advaitasiddhi；munitraya；师承 Sripadaraja。
locator: Wikipedia Vyasatirtha：'Vyāsatīrtha (22 April 1447 – 8 March 1539), also called Vyasaraja or Chandrikacharya, was a Hindu philosopher, scholar, polemicist, commentator and poet belonging to the Madhwacharya's Dvaita order of Vedanta. As the rajaguru of Vijayanagara Empire...'; 'Three of his polemically themed doxographical works Nyayamruta, Tatparya Chandrika and Tarka Tandava (collectively called Vyasa Traya) documented and critiqued an encyclopaedic range of sub-philosophies in Advaita, Visistadvaita, Mahayana Buddhism, Mimamsa and Nyaya, revealing internal contradictions and fallacies.'；页内人物栏模板 'Vyasatirtha (1460–1539)'；柴坦尼亚传承句 'who was a disciple of Vyasatirtha (1469–1539)'；'He studied... the philosophy of Dvaita under Sripadaraja at Mulbagal'.
note: 同一页三种生卒并存；IEP 另作 'Vyasaraya (1478-1589)'（寿逾百岁异常值）——均录不裁决（见 evidenceLimits）。
uncertainty: 生卒三说+IEP 异常值并陈。

claim: 毗耶娑提尔塔建制遗产：Dvaita 曾是'晦暗不明的运动'，经其手转为'fully realised school'；732 尊 Vayu 塑像；哈里达萨扶植（种姓突破收徒）；Vyasayogicharita 圣传性质。
locator: Wikipedia Vyasatirtha：'The philosophy of Dvaita or Tattvavada was an obscure movement within Vedanta in medieval India.'；'Sharma credits Vyasatirtha of converting Dvaita from an obscure movement to a fully realised school of thought of philosophical and dialectical merit.'；'He also contributed to the spread of Dvaita by establishing 732 Vayu idols across Karnataka.'；'Vyasatirtha was also the initiator of social change within the Dvaita order by inducting wandering bards into the mainstream Dvaita movement regardless of caste or creed. This is evident in his initiation of Kanaka Dasa, who was not a Brahmin and Purandara Dasa who was a merchant.'；'Though Vyasayogicharita is a hagiography, unlike other works in the genre, it is free of embellishments such as performance of miracles and some of its claims can be corroborated with inscriptional evidence.'
note: '王座摄政两年'条目维基自标'According to a legend'——本包不写入。

claim: 普兰达拉达萨：哈里达萨游吟者，毗耶娑提尔塔 Dasakuta 论坛与种姓突破收徒的对象（商人出身）；生卒 1484–1564。
locator: Wikipedia Vyasatirtha（Contributions to the Haridasa Movement 节）：'he established a forum of interactions for these bards called Dasakuta and he himself penned several hymns in the vernacular language (Kannada) under the pen name Krishna'；收徒句见 /school/thinkers/2；人物栏 'Purandara Dasa (1484–1564)'；Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta 人物栏列表：'Haridasas Purandara Dasa Kanaka Dasa Vijaya Dasa Gopala Dasa Jagannatha Dasa'（栏目标题与条目名以空格分隔）
note: 非经注哲学家，本包只为呈现非经注面向而收入；'Carnatic 音乐之父'等通行评价未见于核读来源，不写。

claim: 商羯罗（站内人物）作为摩陀婆批判对象：IEP 定位其立场为 atman 与 brahman 完全同一，系于 9 世纪。
locator: IEP Madhva（Madhva and Sankara 节）：'Sankara's A-dvaita or "non-dualist" Vedanta (9th century) argued that the atman is completely identical with brahman.'
note: 站内 philosophers.json 已有页（python 实查）：school='不二论吠檀多（Advaita Vedanta）'，era='约7—8世纪（具体纪年有争议）'——三口径并陈（IEP 9世纪/SEP 约8世纪/站内 7—8世纪）；不二论学说细节归 U03/I04，本包不代述。

claim: 罗摩奴阇（站外接口）：限定不二论立场定位（相异而有潜能同一）。
locator: Wikipedia Dvaita Vedanta：'Vishishtadvaita of Ramanuja which posits qualified nondualism—that ultimate reality (Brahman) and human soul are different but with the potential to be identical.'
note: 本包未核读罗摩奴阇专页，生卒等细节归 I04 包（传统 1017–1137 / 约1077–1157 并陈）；维基 Madhvacharya 页侧证其主张'Jiva (human souls) and Brahman (as Vishnu) are different, a difference that is never transcended'。

claim: 摩陀婆→商羯罗：正面攻击、'伪装佛教'指控、四部专批书、tat tvam asi 重读。
locator: 见 /school/overview/12、/school/overview/13 verbatim（IEP 'vociferously attacked' 句与维基 'most ardent critic... teaching Buddhism under the cover of Vedanta' 句、四部书句、atat tvam asi 句）
note: 'māyāvāda 不可救药'名言未核到，不写（见 evidenceLimits）。

claim: 摩陀婆→罗摩奴阇：拒绝限定不二论为不彻底中间立场；灵魂论多元度对比。
